title: Senior Director, Paid Social
description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Senior Director, Paid Social: the head of Darkroom’s Paid Social practice. This is an executive leadership role. You’ll own the strategy, performance, and commercial health of the practice, lead a team of Associate Directors, Paid Social Managers, and Specialists, and be accountable for the outcomes paid social delivers across Darkroom’s entire client portfolio.

The ideal candidate is a recognized expert in Meta direct response advertising who has already built and run a paid social organization at scale. You’ve scaled multiple ad accounts well beyond $1M USD per month, led teams that include managers of managers, and served as a trusted strategic advisor to CMOs and founders. You think in systems, not campaigns, and you know how to build an organization that runs those systems well without you in every account.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of Paid Media and sit on the Paid Media leadership team, partnering with Darkroom leadership on practice growth, margin, hiring, and the evolution of our service offering. You’ll collaborate closely with Paid Search, Programmatic, Creative, Analytics, Growth Strategy, and Shadow, and will be responsible for building the next generation of paid social leaders at Darkroom.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment for leaders who want to shape how a practice operates and grows. You’ll have the scope to define what best-in-class paid social looks like at Darkroom, and the influence to make it the standard across every account we touch.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you’ll do:

- Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and performance of Darkroom’s Paid Social practice, setting the direction for how the practice grows across platforms, verticals, and service lines.

- Sit on the Paid Media leadership team and partner with the Managing Director on practice OKRs, annual planning, budgeting, and headcount.

- Own the practice’s commercial health, including revenue, margin, client retention, account growth, and team utilization, and report on it to Darkroom leadership.

- Shape Darkroom’s paid social service offering, defining scopes, pricing inputs, and new service lines as the platform landscape shifts.

- Lead Paid Social’s role in new business, partnering with the Growth team on pitches, audits, and proposals, and joining final-round pitches for key prospects.

title: Director, Partner Execution Office
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE:

We are seeking a senior partner leader to drive one of the most consequential company-wide initiatives underway at Everpure. We go to market through partners, and our next phase of growth will come from deepening that model by designing for partners from the start, in every function. As Director, Partner Operating Model, you will be the company's key advisor and expert on this effort: reimagining how we engage our partner ecosystem across the full go-to-market and product lifecycle, and across every organization that touches it. This is a rare mandate to shape how an entire company operates, with results that affect the long-term success of the company. The work reaches well beyond the Global Partner Organization (GPO), and you will be the one driving it.

You will be the GPO leader for the program, bringing the partner lens, the partner voice and the stakeholder alignment that make the recommendations real, with wide latitude to set objectives and approaches for critical assignments. You will understand and validate how our partner processes work end to end, test findings against field and partner reality, assess partner impact and feasibility of proposed changes, and carry final recommendations into workstream charters. From there, you will own the outcome, not just the recommendations. Over a multi-year horizon, you will move from shaping the assessment to leading cross-functional execution of the multi-year roadmap.

This is a thought-leadership and influence role, not a program coordination role. You will build formal networks with key decision makers, be the face of this work with the top leaders of every organization, and serve as an external spokesperson on partner-led go-to-market. You will be expected to form a point of view and defend it with evidence in front of executive stakeholders across Global Sales, Finance, Digital Transformation, Product, Marketing and Customer Experience, and then hold each organization to the plan.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Represent GPO and the partner perspective in the company-wide assessment

• Set the approach for and lead the socialization plan, driving early alignment with key functions and decision makers to secure buy-in for discovery

• Bring deep knowledge of partner workflows and identify partner-related initiatives already underway across functions

• Provide partner go-to-market expertise and clarify applicable partner programs throughout cross-functional discovery

• Validate findings against partner experience and field realities 

• Shape priorities and the future state from the partner perspective, including future concepts where information is limited

• Assess partner impact and implementation feasibility for each opportunity identified

• Confirm final decision owners and recommend sequencing from the partner perspective, with a long-term view of strategic goals

• Pressure test the feasibility of the proposed future-state operating model and the path to get there

• Shape recommendations so they reflect how partners actually do business

• Develop partner-focused metrics for functional scorecards, for both organizations and their leaders, to drive continuous monitoring across multiple functions

• Bring the partner voice into the work

• Engage a cohort of key partners across Resellers, Distributors, MSPs and GSIs to test what they consider critical

• Gather and synthesize input from theater leaders across AMS,

description:
Alkira is the leader in AI-Native Network Infrastructure-as-a-Service (NIaaS). Founded in 2018 by Amir and Atif Khan - the team behind Viptela and the founding of the SD-WAN market - Alkira unifies any environment, site, or user through an enterprise network built entirely in the cloud, managed with the same controls, policies, and security systems network teams already know, and augmented by AI. There is no hardware to deploy, no software to download, and no new architecture to learn. Alkira is trusted by Fortune 100 enterprises, leading system integrators, and global managed service providers, and is part of Lumen Technologies.
We are growing our Sales team and we are looking for a Sales Professional based in the New Jersey region. We are looking for a high energy, dedicated professional who can help add new enterprise clients to our NIaaS platform. This is a full-time position with great benefits and great career potential. The ideal candidate is able to develop and implement a sales strategy that meets company goals and excels at the following job responsibilities:
Responsibilities:

• Work deals from start to close. These may originate from marketing leads, your cold calling efforts, opportunities set up by your partners, or your own rolodex.

• Understanding the market and the challenges prospects face, mapping accounts key decision makers, identifying their purchase obstacles and understanding how our solutions could help them.

• Pitching our solution through engaging presentations and targeted platform demos to enterprise companies.

• Guide and assist prospects through platform trials with our team to ensure our value offering is properly perceived.

• Communicate the value of Alkira solutions and position in the marketplace.

• Responsible for meeting/exceeding revenue targets for your region.

• Effectively manage and orchestrate the closing of large deals within complex and extended sales cycles.

• Providing feedback to ensure continuous strategy and process optimization.

• Leveraging the support from engineering, product management, marketing, finance, and executives to close deals.

Minimum Requirements:

• Minimum 3+ years of technology sales, preferably in networking

• Experience with SaaS, cloud, and security preferred.

• Experience selling to and working with C-Level and top line management to understand business strategy and objectives.

• Experience building and managing a sales territory full of high performing sellers.

• Strong passion for sales and creating long-lasting professional relationships.

• High level of skills in using Salesforce, excel and PowerPoint.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent years of related experience

ABOUT ALKIRA
Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.
Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.
Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.
At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.
Join us and help build the future of networking.

title: Engineering Manager Embedded
description:
Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars.
Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor.
Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence.
If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

THE ROLE

You'll lead marketing operations and analytics at Cohere. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers.

The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

THE TEAM

You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack.

MEASUREMENT

The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend.

SYSTEMS AND DATA

Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end to end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read.

Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric.

BUDGET AND PLANNING NUMBERS

You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

In the first 90 days, you'll document the attribution methodology and get it signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit.

By three months, one governed executive dashboard has replaced the competing decks in business reviews, and rebuilt lead routing is in production.

By six months, target-account reporting reconciles to the governed list, and anyone on the team can reproduce quarterly attribution from the documented method, with change control on the data underneath it. The stack is smaller than when you arrived, and some marketing workflows run on age

title: Principal Field Engineer, US Remote
description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.

You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build the demos the whole team uses: flagship demos, sample apps, cookbooks and reference architectures that show Exa on real problems, and keep them current as the product ships

- Design and deliver workshops, hands-on labs and technical webinars for prospects, customers and developer communities, and package them so any Field Engineer can run them

- Create on-demand training content: video tutorials, self-paced courses and recorded labs that teach customers, developers and new Field Engineers how to build with Exa, without anyone in the room

- Represent Exa at events: conference talks, booth demos, hackathons and partner events, in person, wherever the audience is

- Start and run meetups and user groups in key cities, and grow a community of developers building with Exa

- Be the team's subject-matter expert on Exa's products, search quality, evals and agent use cases; join key deals and customer escalations when SAs and FDEs need deeper help

- Turn new launches into field-ready material: demos, talk tracks and competitive positioning, so the team can sell what Product ships on day one

- Partner with Marketing on technical content, blog posts and events that generate pipeline

- Bring what you hear back to Product: what developers try to build, where they get stuck, and what competitors are doing

REQUIREMENTS

- Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build polished demos and sample apps from scratch, fast, and you enjoy it

- 4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (solutions architect, sales engineer, developer advocate or similar), ideally at an AI-native, API or developer-first company

- A track record of teaching and presenting to technical audiences: talks, workshops, webinars, video tutorials or community events

- Strong communication skills: you can hold a room of engineers, then explain the same thing simply to an executive

- Self-directed: you can set your own priorities without a segment or a quota to tell you where to go

- Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including internationally

YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU...

- Have spoken at developer conferences, run a meetup, or built a community around a technical product

- Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

- Have a following or a body of public work: open-source projects, technical blog posts, talks, videos

title: QTC Analyst
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

About Delinea

Delinea is an identity security platform that helps organizations control what human, machine and AI identities can access-and for how long. Its platform supports just-in-time authorization and Zero Standing Privilege across on-premises and cloud environments.

The role

Delinea’s Quote-to-Cash process runs on Salesforce, supporting products, pricing, quotes, approvals, contracts, orders, amendments, renewals and billing hand-offs. It currently uses Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ), with a planned migration to Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) and Revenue Cloud Billing (RCB) in 2027.

As a hands-on member of the Quote-to-Cash Business Systems team, you’ll split your time between production support and building enhancements. You’ll manage support tickets in Jira Service Management and deliver project work through Azure DevOps. A platform lead and senior developers set standards and own the most complex architecture; you’ll own your tickets and stories end to end.

What you’ll do

- Troubleshoot Quote-to-Cash issues, from quotes and approvals to amendments, renewals and billing hand-offs. Identify root causes, resolve issues within SLA, communicate clearly and escalate with useful context when needed.

- Maintain Salesforce CPQ, including products and bundles, pricing and product rules, approvals, quote templates, contracting, amendments and renewals.

- Help design, build, test and deliver the 2027 migration to Revenue Cloud Advanced and Revenue Cloud Billing, including catalog, pricing, configuration, transaction management, orchestration and billing.

- Deliver enhancements using Salesforce configuration, Flow, Apex or Lightning Web Components; test changes and follow controlled release processes.

- Support migration data and parallel running, including mapping CPQ data and helping move products, price books, contracts and assets.

- Monitor scheduled jobs and Salesforce integrations with NetSuite, billing and provisioning systems, including Boomi processes.

- Trace provisioning issues across quotes, contracts, subscriptions, assets and downstream systems; correct root causes and document approvals and evidence for access changes.

- Maintain Confluence knowledge articles, how-to guides and runbooks, and help users adapt as processes move from CPQ to RCA.

How you’ll work

You’ll partner with Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Order Management and Finance; prioritize by business impact, especially at quarter-end; and collaborate with Business Systems Analysts, the platform lead and senior developers. You’ll coordinate across time zones, communicate risks early, follow approved testing and release workflows, and use AI tools responsibly by verifying their output.

What you’ll bring

- 3+ years building and supporting Salesforce in production, including at least 2 years hands-on with Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ).

- Experience with CPQ products and bundles, price and product rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approvals, contracts, amendments and renewals.

- Hands-on exposure to Revenue Cloud Advanced or Revenue Cloud Billing through a project, sandbox or Trailhead, and an understanding of how its model differs from CPQ.

- Strong Salesforce Flow skills and judgment about when to use configuration, Flow

title: Head of Group Distribution Economics
description:
Head of Distribution Economics
As Head of Distribution Economics, you serve as a key member of the Group Benefits Distribution Operations leadership team and are responsible for creating and leading Guardian ’s total Distribution expense and partner investment strategy. The responsibilities include owning of our Sales Planning Process, our Distribution Compensation Strategy, execution of our compensation and planning operations, and oversight of our total Distribution expense spend. You will help Guardian determine where Distribution investment dollars should be placed, how those investment decisions are governed, and how value creation is measured across the entire Distribution ecosystem. This role extends beyond compensation strategy and administration into strategic business unit investment management, governance, financial stewardship, portfolio optimization, and executive decision support. Compensation Operations is a component of this role and reports to the Head of Distribution Economics. This role reports to the Head of Distribution Operations, Group Benefits.

You will partner with Finance, Pricing, Product, Underwriting, HR, Partnership Management, and Distribution leadership to turn Distribution spend into clear trade-offs and decision-ready recommendations.

You will
Provide strategic leadership for Total Distribution Expense across Group Benefits, including partner economics, the broker supplemental compensation and incentive investment view, internal compensation, GA/COE, BenTech/API, enrollment support, and market access strategies.
Answer the core question for the business: where should our Distribution investment dollars by invested, governed, measured, reallocated, redesigned, or sunset.
Lead portfolio management of Distribution investments, including portfolio trade-offs, prioritization, investment recommendations, economic guardrails, and renewal, redesign, and sunset recommendations.
Build and run governance for material Distribution investment decisions, including intake, approval readiness standards, decision log, RACI, scorecards, review cadence, and enforcement triggers.
Evaluate strategic partner fee programs, BenAdmin administrative fee programs, enrollment firms, and broker platforms to determine whether each investment is justified, measurable, strategically aligned, and subject to stewardship commitments.
Connect Finance compensation analytics with partnership management, pricing, funding, profitability, persistency, and market-access economics to inform enterprise trade-offs.
Establish scorecard accountability for Distribution investments and drive the reallocation of underperforming spend toward higher-value opportunities.
Build economic models, scenario analyses, and ROI frameworks that quantify the cost, return, and risk of Distribution investment alternatives.
Deliver decision-ready executive recommendations to Group Benefits and Distribution leadership, and facilitate leader conversations on funding trade-offs, growth objectives, and investment priorities.
Lead the Compensation Operations sub-function, which reports to this role and owns compensation plan design and implementation, calculation, administration, sales credit, commission and override payments, compliance, and payment integrity for internal and external programs. Ensure compensation execution is accurate, compliant, and aligned with Distribution investment decisions.
Build strong relationships across Distribution, specifically with the Regional Vice Presidents (RVPs) across all segments and Client Management heads (HCMs), as well as Finance, Pricing, Legal, and Partnership Management, to provide consultation and partnership and to identify needs and priorities.
Lead, hire, develop, and manage the Distribution Economics team, including the Compensation Operations sub-function.
Stay abreast of and ensure alignment with legal, regulatory, and market requirements affecting Distribution expense, compensation, and partner arrangements

title: Senior Strategic Program Manager

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.

xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.

We are building for the lives people want to live.

title: Sr Accountant, Financial Reporting - GAAP
description:
UFG is currently seeking a Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting - GAAP who is responsible for supporting the preparation, analysis, and reporting of the Company's quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, SEC filings, and related financial reporting deliverables. This role ensures the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), SEC reporting requirements, and company policies.
Working closely with Financial Reporting leadership, Financial Accounting, Investments, FP&A, Actuarial, and other Finance teams, the Senior Accountant supports the preparation of financial statement disclosures, supporting schedules, SEC filings, and investment-related reporting. This position also assists with financial analysis, internal controls, process improvement initiatives, and audit support activities. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong financial reporting skills, attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Financial Reporting - GAAP

• Prepare and support the review of quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, SEC filings (including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K), financial statement disclosures, supporting schedules, and related reporting documentation, ensuring compliance with generally accepted accounting principles and SEC reporting requirements.

• Analyze financial results, balances, and trends and investigate unusual fluctuations or reporting variances.

• Support investment accounting and reporting activities, including preparation of investment-related schedules, analyses, and financial statement disclosures.

• Assist with implementation of new accounting standards, accounting policies, and reporting requirements.

• Prepare select journal entries and account reconciliations related to assigned financial reporting responsibilities.

• Prepare documentation supporting financial reporting conclusions and disclosure requirements.

• Maintain current knowledge of financial reporting requirements, SEC developments, industry trends, and best practices.

Governance & Controls

• Maintain SOX-compliant documentation, ensuring adherence to company policies and internal control requirements.

• Assist with audit requests, including internal controls and testing evidence.

Collaboration & Process Improvement

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing processes, standardizing reporting, and automating data flow.

• Mentor other team members by sharing knowledge and modeling best practices in accounting and financial reporting.

• Support system enhancements and testing related to accounting or financial reporting applications.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including operations and IT to support finance transformation initiatives designed to modernize systems and standardize financial processes.

• Perform other duties as assigned to support the finance department and company goals.

Job Specifications:
Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or progress toward certification preferred

• Master’s degree in accounting or MBA preferred

Experience:

• 5 years of financial reporting or insurance accounting experience.

• Prior experience within property and casualty insurance preferred.

• Experience preparing or supporting GAAP financial statements and related disclosures.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Strong understanding of generally accepted accounting principles and financial statement presentation requirements.

• Knowledge of SEC reporting requirements and disclosure practices preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to accuracy and detail.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, complex formulas).

• Experience with financial systems and subledger

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

We are looking for a Director, Global Risk & Compliance to establish and lead the firm's first centralized risk management and compliance function. This role will build the enterprise risk framework, develop and implement global policies (AI governance, data privacy, vendor risk management, ESG compliance), manage the corporate insurance program, and coordinate compliance execution across all regions.
This role will serve as the client-facing risk leader, engaging directly with enterprise clients on compliance questionnaires, security assessments, and risk governance. The role partners closely with the VP of IT and Sr. Security Engineer to ensure the enterprise risk framework reflects both business and technology dimensions.
This is a governance and framework role, not a technical security engineering role. The Director defines risk policy and requirements ("what" and "why"); the Sr. Security Engineer implements at the infrastructure level ("how"). The two roles operate as complements with a clear boundary.

Risk Management & Oversight

• Partner with executive leadership to define Blend360 's risk appetite and tolerance thresholds; translate those into a practical risk management framework with clear escalation protocols across all the global enterprise.

• Create and maintain a master risk register that tracks business, operational, regulatory, and technology risks; record who owns each risk, its likelihood and potential impact, and how we'll address it

• Run annual risk reviews across all regions and business units; use the external Global Risk Assessment (expected Q3 2026) to benchmark our findings

• Design incident response procedures and lead after-incident reviews to track fixes to completion

• Track data safety across the company, from how it's collected and processed to how it's shared and moved across borders (for both client and internal data)

• Review client projects for risks related to cloud, data, and AI components; provide risk-based recommendations to support legal review and deal decisions

Vendor & Third-Party Risk Management

Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.

You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.
